note: No OFI rule passed the deploy gate (no measured-cost 95% CI lower bound > 0; fails OOS; DSR=0.000; White's p=0.771). Per the predeclared gate, the single most-promising predeclared rule is locked as a CANDIDATE and the live run is an OUT-OF-SAMPLE FALSIFICATION TEST, not a deployment.
rule_definition: ofi>0 -> LONG, ofi<0 -> SHORT (trade in the direction of net aggressive flow on the signal bar)
entry: next executable price on the live book: LONG at best ASK, SHORT at best BID (taker)
exit: H=120s later: LONG marks out at best BID, SHORT at best ASK
selection_basis: highest in-sample (first 14d) mean net at its best horizon among the 4 predeclared rules at primary tau=0 (follow_flow@120s, IS mean +3.5 bps fees-only)
live_cost_model: The live paper trader crosses the real book (enter at ask / exit at bid), so the real spread is PAID and must NOT be double-counted; only the 8bp round-trip taker fee is subtracted on top. This live cost model sits between the backtest fees_only (optimistic) and measured_p50 (which added a modelled spread on top of a mid-ish trade price).
prediction_for_live: Expected realized net ~<= 0 bps/trade. Live realized spread is paid explicitly, so realistic expectation is closer to the measured_p50 (negative) than the fees_only (~+2bp) case. This is a FALSIFICATION test of whether flow-following clears real costs live.

secondary_observation.why: The only cell whose fees-only 95% CI lower bound exceeded 0 (mean +9.5bps, CI [1.3, 19.1]); still fails under measured spread (CI [-13.2, 4.3]) and tau!=0 is diagnostic-only, not a valid selection. Recorded so the live monitor logs ofi and move on every event and both rules can be evaluated offline.

sizing.reason: candidate-only (no gate pass): fixed notional for clean per-trade bps measurement, not Kelly sizing

universe: 33 liquid perps (qvol>=$2M) from research/data/universe.json + BTCUSDT beta reference
detector: reconstruct aster_pulse flagged() on the live 30s grid: |move|>=0.5%, |z|>=4 vs BTC beta-adjusted, volume burst>=3x
